base.note: Focused preexam frontend patch over the current v1.6.0 baseline.

changes.CANONICAL_HIGH_161: Explicit A16 tier is authoritative; corpus fallback cannot promote explicit MEDIA/BAJA into MUY_ALTA+ALTA.
changes.HISTORICAL_EXPOSURE_161: OBSERVADA_* remains study-eligible and counts toward historical exposure while staying excluded from adaptive domain/weakness/due/speed metrics.
changes.EDITORIAL_SCOPE_161: Custom practice can select all historical, valid only, or observed only; all historical is the default.
changes.DASHBOARD_SPLIT_161: High unseen is shown as valid + observed = historical exposure pending.
changes.MEDIA134_161: Adds the frozen 134-anchor MEDIA queue (one selected anchor per MEDIA topic) and builder filter without modifying the question dataset; deep QR audit is 60/134 and not yet applied.
changes.FINAL4DAY_PLAN_161: High historical exposure first; MEDIA134 with >=3 days to exam; consolidation with <=2 days.
changes.NO_LETTER_LEARNER_TEXT_161: Runtime learner-facing editorial prose replaces explicit A–E references with the corresponding option text and strips answer-letter prefixes from current-answer displays/learning-note exports; stored bank rows remain untouched until the later Supabase editorial delta.
changes.SIMULATOR_PRESERVED: Universal paper exam behavior from v1.5.9 is unchanged.
changes.PROTECTED_SESSION_FILES: session-core.js and session-storage.js remain byte-identical to v1.6.0.
changes.MEDIA_OBSERVED_161_R2: MEDIA observed historical questions remain explicit study material and receive their own preexam queue after high exposure closes.
changes.TASK_ORDER_161_R2: During high rescue, unseen high precedes backlog reviews; during MEDIA acquisition, errors/doubts precede MEDIA anchors/observed forms so a large due backlog cannot hide the active preexam objective.
changes.ADAPTIVE_TOPIC_METRICS_161_R2: Mi Estado keeps canonical historical coverage over all questions but recalculates topic weakness/doubt/overdue using only non-observed questions.
changes.MEDIA134_LABEL_ACCURACY_161_R2: UI says selected MEDIA anchors, not that all 134 quick references are already audited/applied; current QR audit remains 60/134 and not yet in production.
changes.LETTER_HYGIENE_161_R3: Predeploy audit found that legacy QRV2 fields can still contain phrases such as “alternativa C” or “D. ...”. v1.6.1 now sanitizes those references at render/export time using the actual option text, without mutating source questions or content hashes.
changes.MEDIA134_CANONICAL_GUARD_161_R3: Both the automated MEDIA134 queue and the manual builder filter revalidate that each frozen anchor still carries explicit canonical tier MEDIA before including it.

qa.manual_smoke: RECOMMENDED_AFTER_DEPLOY_BEFORE_SIMULACRO: reopen/hard refresh, verify visible v1.6.1, simulator hub 200 A+B, custom practice editorial filter, and Dashboard high/MEDIA-priority split.

dataset_revision_note: Última revisión de producción confirmada por el paquete R07; v1.6.1 no modifica el dataset. Exportar public.questions fresco después del simulacro antes del próximo patch clínico-editorial.
